individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a set of histology micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

The top box plot of total polyp number is exempt (box plots already show distribution), but the 3D bar chart of polyp number by diameter shows only mean bars per genotype/size category without any overlaid individual mouse data points.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
The bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 shows only mean bars with no individual data points overlaid.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
The bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows only mean bars with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A is a photograph with no error bars or box-plot elements.
not needed - Panel B is a set of micrographs with no error bars or box-plot elements.

FAIL - The box plot in panel C shows whiskers/box elements (and the bar chart may include variability) but the caption only gives sample size and P-values without stating what the box, whiskers, or any error bars represent (e.g., min/max, IQR, SD, SEM).
not needed - Kaplan-Meier survival curves do not display error bars.
FAIL - The bar chart of GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels shows error bars, but the caption does not state whether these represent SD, SEM, or another measure of variability.
not needed - Panel F is a set of immunohistochemistry micrographs with no error bars.
FAIL - The relative expression bar chart in panel G shows error bars and significance asterisks, but the caption does not define what the error bars represent (e.g., SD or SEM).
